title: CrestApps AI Data Sources (Azure AI Search) configuration
description: The settings of the Azure AI Search data source module read from appsettings.json, in the OrchardCore section of the host or a tenant.

AzureAISearch.description: What an Azure AI Search data source on this tenant may reach while signing in as the site's host.

HostIdentityIndexes.description: The search service, index and identity a data source on this tenant may use with a managed identity, the default Azure credential or a data connection without authentication. Only needed on tenants other than the default one; set it in the tenant's own configuration.

Endpoint.description: The search service's address, such as https://my-service.search.windows.net.

IndexName.description: The index the data source may read.

IdentityClientId.description: The client ID of the user-assigned managed identity. Leave it out for the system-assigned identity or the default credential.
